notes.title: Big update 0.2.5
notes.content:
Big update 0.2.5

Game has been updated to version 0.2.5

This update has completely overhauled the skill system in the game.
-All skills are divided into 8 groups: Melee, Ranged, Crafting, Assassin, Water Magic, Fire Magic, Dark Magic, Light Magic.
-Added "Skill tree"
-Now you can improve the attributes for gold from some teachers.
-Added more teachers
-Added magic altars
-Improvement of the interface
-Fixed bug with music volume
-Added some new items
-Fixed bugs

To learn skills, you need find a master, each skill costs a learn points and gold.

To use magic spells, you need buy a magic staff.

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
Game has been updated to version 0.2. 


 Game now has a new save / load system. Now the saves are located in the folder -
 "... / Documents / NaudrionSaves" 

 If you have lost your progress, you can restore it using cheats. To do this, start the game, open menu and click button in upper left corner of menu window.

 Increased day length
 Improved interaction with items and characters.
 Added some hints
 Fixed bug dialogue with merchant
 Fixed the instant disappearance of some monsters after death
 Fixed interface bugs
 Fixed daily routine for some NPCs
 Added new items to merchants
 Other minor bugs fixed


Only skills can be assigned to the shortcut keys (1-7), to equip the weapon use the "F" button. I'm already working on adding items from the inventory to quick access, this will be added in the next update.
